note: Migration queue importer schedules Migrate API migrations to run on cron via the Queue API. It defines a cron_migration config entity (config name migrate_queue_importer.cron_migration.<id>) with keys id, label, migration (migration plugin id string), time (interval in SECONDS), update, sync, ignore_dependencies (booleans); status is the entity key (enabled/disabled). hook_cron() queues active, due cron migrations (and dependencies) onto the 'migrations_importer' queue, whose QueueWorker runs MigrateExecutable::import(). One permission: 'administer cron migrations'. UI at /admin/config/migrate_queue_importer/cron_migration. Requires migrate_tools + migrate_plus. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real cron_migration config entities; the referenced migration ids are stored as plain strings (the entity does not require the migration to exist), so cases can use placeholder migration ids without importing anything.

evals.prompt: How does the migrate_queue_importer module actually run a migration, and when? What Drupal subsystem does it use to do the work?
evals.expected_output: On each cron run its hook_cron() finds active cron_migration entities whose interval has elapsed and pushes them onto the 'migrations_importer' queue; a QueueWorker then imports each via MigrateExecutable::import(). So migrations run on cron through the Queue API, not immediately.

evals.prompt: In migrate_queue_importer, what config entity represents a scheduled migration, and what are its main fields (including how the schedule interval is expressed)?
evals.expected_output: The cron_migration config entity (migrate_queue_importer.cron_migration.<id>) with keys id, label, migration (the migration plugin id), time (interval in seconds), and the boolean flags update, sync and ignore_dependencies, plus a status (enabled/disabled).

evals.prompt: When migrate_queue_importer queues a migration, what do the per-migration 'update' and 'sync' options do, and what is the queue/worker called?
evals.expected_output: update re-imports rows (calls prepareUpdate() on the id map); sync removes destination items missing from the source (sets syncSource). The queue and QueueWorker plugin id is 'migrations_importer'.

evals.prompt: This site has a scheduled migration configured with migrate_queue_importer named mqi_known. Inspect the live configuration and state which migration id it imports and its interval.
evals.expected_output: mqi_known imports the migration 'mqi_sample_migration' with time (interval) 3600 seconds (migrate_queue_importer.cron_migration.mqi_known).

evals.prompt: A cron migration named mqi_flags is configured on this site (migrate_queue_importer). Inspect the live configuration and state which of the update / sync / ignore_dependencies flags is enabled.
evals.expected_output: Only the 'sync' flag is enabled on mqi_flags (update and ignore_dependencies are false); see migrate_queue_importer.cron_migration.mqi_flags.

evals.prompt: Using the migrate_queue_importer module, create an enabled cron migration with machine name mqi_task that schedules the migration 'mqi_target_migration' to run with an interval of 600 seconds. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A cron_migration config entity mqi_task exists, enabled (status true), with migration='mqi_target_migration' and time=600 (migrate_queue_importer.cron_migration.mqi_task).

evals.prompt: This site has an enabled cron migration named mqi_toggle (migrate_queue_importer). Disable it so it is no longer picked up on cron runs, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The cron_migration entity mqi_toggle has status false (disabled), e.g. via the disable action/link or $entity->disable()->save().
